known_issue.reason: Icarus 13.0 aborts on a runtime array-query dimension (vpiBinaryConst::vpi_get: get 83 not supported). A standalone integer-dimension reproducer instead reports that $left expects an array and optionally an integer. IEEE 1800-2023 20.7 permits a runtime expression selecting a fixed-size dimension.

known_issue.reason: Icarus 13.0 rejects fixed-size array queries in localparams (a reference to mem is not allowed in a constant expression) and query operands naming typedefs (Type names are not valid expressions here). IEEE 1800-2023 20.7 permits both. Verilator passes the case.
